'Înapoi la jocuri' does nothing when the failure happened on '/', and the copy blames a game
The inline h1 ref callback pulls focus back to the heading on every re-render while the error screen is shown
New auto-fit word grids produce ragged 3-column boards (Conexiuni 3/3/3/3/3/1, Intrusul 3/1, Perechi 3/3/2) at intermediate text sizes and on narrow viewports
Cald sau Rece: 'Reguli și ajutor' now opens inside a half-width grid cell (177px on a 390px phone, 463px tall) and pushes 'Opțiuni de joc' onto a new row
Lanț route words and Alchimie inventory labels still break mid-word on phones; V1's long-word fix covered only three games
Lanț's new current position is never announced to screen readers (no live region; the progress status omits the word and is absent on Greu and after Back/sync)

Inconsistent tile capitalization gives away Conexiuni groups and Intrusul answers

The 'Reguli și ajutor' and 'încearcă un indiciu' instructions do not match Alchimie exploration or the hint gating in most games
The claim 'colecția Alchimie are propriul mecanism de salvare' is misleading: the collection is only in this browser and cannot be exported

No iPhone/Safari (WebKit) coverage exists, and the guide does not ask the organizer to include one
Guide wording does not match the exact UI labels (circuit, Export, words vs concepts) and uses jargon unsuitable for children and seniors
Import error toast is missing a diacritic and uses jargon
README is stale: no link to the tester guide, wrong newest ADR and wrong graph counts and fixture version
agent-testing.md does not describe the environment V1 was actually verified on
After finishing the daily, the start screen still offers the same daily as the main button because nothing removes ?challenge=daily from the URL, and no test covers this
If the optional AccountBar chunk fails to load, all of Home is replaced by 'Nu am putut încărca jocul.', its 'Înapoi la jocuri' link does nothing on '/', and an e2e test locks this behavior in

In the 'slow failed chunk' unit test, the loop that 'expires every scheduled timeout' now does nothing
A first-ever loss (0 points) shows '★ Record!', plays the record sound, and later shows as 'Recordul tău: 0 · pierdut'
Lanț error messages shown to players are missing diacritics, and the most common one does not say what to do next
Conexiuni hint text says 'ramas' without its diacritic, and its underscore letter pattern has no explanation
Singular/plural mismatches players will see: 'GREȘELI 1 rămase', history '1 greșeli', tooltip 'după încă 1 încercări'

The mistake budget has different names across screens: greșeli / încercări / vieți

Copied result texts are missing diacritics and singular forms ('1 încercări', 'greseli', 'Lantul Cuvintelor', 'mutari'), and the score-import error says 'Fisierul'
Daily-challenge badges show a raw ISO date ('ZILNIC 2026-09-23') instead of Romanian date format
The version is hand-copied into five places with no test tying them together, and neither the lobby badge nor any endpoint shows the exact build
The CRLF-tolerant release reserve fails the builder's own check mode on a Windows autocrlf checkout
The SPA shell at "/" is cacheable for 60 s (public) while deep links get no Cache-Control, so the shell's cache policy is inconsistent after a redeploy

deferred_reasons.title: Hundreds of served descriptions and edge labels have no diacritics, and 'roman' (Roman or novel) is used where 'român' (Romanian) is meant. This includes the repaired Ateneul node's own direct edges. / Target descriptions typed without diacritics are shown to players, and some change meaning (for example "Sculptor roman" and "statul roman")
deferred_reasons.reason: Any kg_sample.json byte change invalidates kg_sha256, which is pinned in board_rankings_v37 (the loader fails closed), derived_catalog_v38, quick_games_v92, alchimie_recipe_extensions_v92, tests/current_content.py, content_history.py and STATUS. It also needs a new sibling of apply_v1_factual_repairs.py, which is pinned to the pre-V1 baseline, plus editorial review, because 'roman' is correct for Traian, Columna, Dacia, and for novels. WP9 adds a known-limit line so testers do not spend feedback on it. Next content wave: an orthography-only batch over the roughly 82 eligible target nodes, gated by normalize(new)==normalize(old), with a non-failing validator warning. The edge labels matter less; only Alchimie why-links show raw label_ro.

deferred_reasons.title: False KG casting edge "Toma Caragiu a jucat în Reconstituirea" appears as a Lanț opening choice
deferred_reasons.reason: The factual error is real, but removing de451 alone turns validate_games_pack RED: lt_arta_cultura_095 falls to one first-hop choice, below LANT_MIN_FIRST_HOP_CHOICES=2. It needs a bound proposal that removes the edge and demotes the board, independent review and the full rebinding cascade. Do it first in the next content wave. Low traffic: salience 0.23 and one eligible Lanț board.

deferred_reasons.title: Lanț lt_personalitati_186 (usor, top selection weight) can only be solved through generic nodes "bărbat", "carieră" or "om"
deferred_reasons.reason: The fix is exclusion from selection. The sealed V1 reserve manifest pins count==20, its digest and independent-review bindings (release_reserve.py:13/74/83), so the alternative is Paul's owner-demotion list. Both need ranking regeneration. This is a content-selection decision for the next wave, not a code hardening item.

deferred_reasons.title: Conexiuni Limbă·Greu and Geografie·Greu each hold a single eligible board, and that board is off-theme
deferred_reasons.reason: Reserving or recategorising cx_limba_192 and cx_geografie_179 changes the sealed reserve or pack records. That needs review, count and constant changes, ranking regeneration and an ADR addendum. WP9 documents single-board shelves as a known limit. Batch it with the other selection holds in the next content wave.

deferred_reasons.title: The repaired Ateneul description opens with the unidiomatic 'Clădire de concerte'
deferred_reasons.reason: Polish only. It needs a KG edit with the full rebinding cascade. Batch it with the diacritics wave, using 'Sală de concerte din București, sediul Filarmonicii „George Enescu”…' without the year.

deferred_reasons.title: Label spelling errors on eligible boards: missing diacritics in cx_istorie_001 group labels, "Mică Unire 1859" and "Herta Muller"
deferred_reasons.reason: The group labels have an existing PackLabelCorrection rail, but it still changes games_pack.json and the derived catalogs. The KG relabels (use 'Mica Unire 1859' and 'Herta Müller', without the old-form aliases, because alias_unique would reject them) need the KG transaction. Batch with the content wave.

deferred_reasons.title: Alchimie Greu on-demand generator latency (code bound)
deferred_reasons.reason: A wall-clock bound breaks deterministic dailies. An attempt-count bound changes which boards seeded dailies produce, and generator tests may pin them. Hiding shelves with zero curated boards is a product change. For V1.0.1 it is documented only (WP9). My measurement shows other players' creates slow to at most 1.7 s during a 14 s start; they are not blocked. Revisit with a deterministic attempt cap plus a 'se pregătește jocul…' hint.

deferred_reasons.title: New V1 history tests tie review claims made at the V1 release to live content, the same pattern V1 itself had to fix in test_v99_lant_captions.py
deferred_reasons.reason: Developer-only, with no tester impact. The next content wave is the first change that will trip these tests, so the hash-pinned post-V1 snapshot refactor belongs there (captions registry snapshot, evidence-derived retained ids, review-time shas instead of live re-hashing).

deferred_reasons.title: Resumed free round from circuit: persistent in-board notice (beyond the WP3 toast)
deferred_reasons.reason: WP3 ships a transient toast plus the Intrusul/Perechi daily result action, which closes the dead end. A persistent notice needs a shared UI slot in all six screens. Revisit if testers still misreport the mode.

deferred_reasons.title: Conexiuni hint: lowercasing joining words in the letter pattern
deferred_reasons.reason: Rejected rather than deferred. It changes the pattern payload and hides the capitals of proper nouns. The explanatory text in WP7 addresses the confusion.
